question: Mr.Jacob invested Rs.17,500 divided into two different schemes A and B at simple interest rate of 20% and 7.5% respectively. If the total amount of the interest earned in 2 years is Rs.3775, What was the amount invested in scheme A. (In Rs.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total interest if all invested in A: 17500 × 40% = ₹7000

Total interest if all invested in B: 17500 × 15% = ₹2625

Applying alligation on total interest (₹3775):

Ratio of A : B = (3775 − 2625) : (7000 − 3775) = 1150 : 3225 = 46 : 129

Amount in Scheme A = [46 ÷ (46 + 129)] × 17500 = 46 × 100 = 4600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Investment = ₹17,500

Scheme A rate = 20% p.a., Scheme B rate = 7.5% p.a.

Time (T) = 2 years, Total Interest = ₹3775

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100
